content: Tsagdutsaga dzidzakh
Farisakha zǝ yakhaya kǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh Mus, ai sarawal ǝn Wurshalim. Dzafkai itar ǝn vak Yasu.
Ka nǝgha itar ad yakhaya kǝ furakh Yasu, ǝn zu kaf itar kwal parga tsitar ad dǝv ndǝke tsagdu dzidzakh tar.
Wirva Farisakha zǝ Yakhudakh daghan, na itar zu kaf kwal parga tsitsar dǝv ndǝke tsagatǝrdu dzidzakh tar bi. Wirvǝn tsufada ndzikha ndzikh dzidzakh tar itar.

Da sa itar ǝn kasuk, na itar ǝn zu kaf bi, akwa pardu itar dǝv ndǝke tsagatǝrdu dzidzakh tar. Ən tsufa tsufa itar ad yakhaya kǝ ndzikha ndzikh tar ai wuru itar zikǝn. Ndǝk zai pardu kwat khǝɓ yu, shakakh, zǝ shugudakhe mangud dǝ vǝrshakanvǝ, zǝ vak zu kafakh tar.

Wirva yan, ka ndiɗarwal Farisakhen zǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikhen kǝ Yasu, “Uɗa lava kǝ furakhagh kwal nǝg ǝn gatars kǝ ndzikha ndzikh dzidzakhǝnd, kǝ zu kaf tsitar kwal par dǝv ndǝkve tsagdu dzidzakhǝndi?”
Ka nggawa tǝrkhai Yasu, ‘Kalkal lav tlayang tlayange tsa kwarga Ishay ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tsukur kur mbaɗirakh. Ndǝke vindzanin kwarne,

content.text: ‘ “Udakhan na uk ǝn fakghǝr dǝ ghay itar,
ǝn tsagdu ndzikha ndzikhe a bǝga ud itar vadge ndzikha ndzikhe a bǝga Yazhigǝl.’

content: Ɗuwars kur gatars kǝ ndzikha ndzikh Yazhigǝl, ǝn gatars kǝ ndzikha ndzikh dzidzakhur kur.”
Ka zu vuk tsin dǝ kwar kwarne, “Nǝg kur dǝ khiɗa ɗuda ndzikha ndzikh Yazhigǝl, kǝ wirva tsuf tsagdutsagur.
Wirva kwarga Mus kwarne, ‘Fargǝrafǝg kǝ dadagha zǝ babagh, ɗaga ude kwarga lav bǝzan ǝn tǝ dad sar awana bab sar, ka kǝɗgud.’
Ai ǝn kwara kwara kur kwarne, da ka nǝv udan kǝ bab sar awana dad sar, dǝge tsa da mǝlakuru ka din, audzala kǝn barkhai kǝ Yazhigǝl. A manga ba dǝ khaip bi.
Wirva yan, a khayarnǝf ba kur kǝ ud ad mǝlaru kǝ dad sara zǝ bab sar bi.
Tǝ dǝva dǝ yan, a nandala kur lav Yazhigǝl kǝ bat, wirva ndzikha ndzikhakh dzidzakhure ǝn tsagardu kur kǝ zarur. Ən manakha mana kur digitakh zikǝn ndǝkva dǝgakhen.
Dagakhe ǝn bǝg udakh da nǝga kǝ kwadlamb ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl
Ka gwidǝn Yasu ad ɗakhga dzakhava udakh, ka ni, “Tsǝnam ka tsǝna itsawar, diyarsǝf kur ad inan.
Na dǝge ǝn ba udan da ghay sar, ai da nan kǝ kwadlamb ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl bi. Akwa dǝge ǝn sǝgo ǝn khuɗ sar da nan kǝ kwadlamb, ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl.
Ɗaga ude dǝ tlim tsǝn lav, tsǝnin ad lavan.
Ən tǝkhal kǝ tǝkaghǝra tsin zǝ dzakhava udakh, ka dagh da mǝgh. Ka ndiɗarwal furakh sar ad dǝge ǝn tuku jakva lavan.
Ka niya tsitar, “Atsuk a katlga bakh ghǝrura? Ən tsa bakh kur kwarne dǝge ǝn ba udan da ghay sar bǝn na ud kǝ kwadlamb ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl biya?
Wirvǝn nabǝn daks da rǝvakhuɗ bi ǝn dǝgdagh da khuɗ, khalakyan ka sǝgawal ǝn vǝgh. (Lav Yasu ǝn tǝ vana, a mǝdlanan kwarne, itsera kǝ dǝg zuwa chuwaɗaɗ kǝ zuwazu.)
Ka zu vuk tsin dǝ kwar lav kwarne, ‘Dǝge sǝgo ǝn khuɗ kǝ uda ǝn nan kǝ kwadlamb ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl.
Wirvǝn rǝvakhuɗ ud ǝn sǝgo nguɗi nguɗi ɗayaghǝrakh, ai bǝgan da man dǝgakhe kwal khwar, ndǝk zai garnak, gǝl, zǝ kǝɗ safa ud.
Gwaragwar, khuwa, kǝlada, valdu ud, kuɗ bǝg zhiru, shilga, bazdu ɗakha ud, nagh ghǝr, zǝ dlǝgǝr dlag.
Daghan dǝg nguɗi nguɗiyakhan, ǝn sǝgo ǝn khuɗ kǝ ud, tsuguna in ǝn nan kǝ kwadlamb ǝn tǝvuk kǝ Yazhigǝl.”
Fadǝghǝrofǝg nuse ǝn kǝs ya Surifiniki
Ka ɗuda Yasu ad vaken, dagh da ǝntla khaya Taya zǝ Sidon. Ka dagh da mǝghen, tsuguna ǝn nagh ba tsatsǝg ak itsawar bi, dǝmbiyanena, a ɓǝghafkhai bi.
Uk tsǝna tsǝna kǝ nuse ǝn kǝɗa shatan ad dughw sar ad lavǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yasu, ka sagha kǝlgan ad juguv ǝn tǝvuk sar.
Nusen tsuguna liye kwal Yakhudakh. A yavǝn Finiki ǝntla khaya ya Suri. Ka tatl Yasu tsin kǝ ɓardal wurdu sǝgawal ǝn vǝgh kǝ dughw sar.
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Ɗuwaks ɗuwa bara bǝg ka dǝg zuwa kǝ zaren (Yakhudakh) ndan, wirva kalkal ba ka ɓatǝrvalud dǝg zuwa zara, ka liyarduwud kǝ ghǝdakh bi.”
Ka nǝv nusen, “Ai ndǝk yan Dad Zikan, ai ghǝdakha ǝn vaɗuvaɗa itar ad kwacha kafakhe a ɓalal ǝn tǝ vǝlang zu kaf zar.”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Wirva lavana a kwargakh, gwiya daks da mǝgh, a tǝkaghǝra wurdu zǝ dughwagh.”
Ka wura da mǝgh, tlarghǝr kǝ dughw sar ǝn khǝngan ǝn tǝ pin, audzala wurduwen ǝn dala dǝg ǝn vǝgh sar.
A mbandu Yasu ad tǝng ai kwal tǝkha kǝ kwarga lav
Ka ɗuwars Yasu ad kǝs ya Taya, ka dal da dǝlva Galili, diwa Sidon zǝ Dikapolis (kǝsakh kǝlɗǝk).
Ka ɓardǝghǝr yakhaya kǝ udakh ad tǝnge dlakh kwar ghay tsin, ka tatl Yasu tsitar kǝ barghǝr dǝv tsin, ki mbǝga tsin.
Tǝkhal kǝ ɗakhga tsin udanen ǝn tǝb kǝ dzakhava udakh da tǝ kalam. Ka ba Yasu ad wirik dǝv sar da tlim kǝ tǝngen, ka tǝfaw ad shaghwvai ǝn tǝ zǝr dǝv sar, ka gǝman ad rikha udanen din.
Ka lando Yasu ad ghǝr da gharazhigǝl, ka gǝlf niya zikzik, ka niya tsin, “Iffata” Dǝge ǝn tukuwina in kwarne “Ngurǝf ngur.”
Kwarga tsin ndǝkyan, ka ngurǝf tlim udanen. Ka tasla nǝv rikh sar a vǝdgan, ka farsa kwar lava tsin khwaraniyan.
Ka ndǝɗatǝrnǝf Yasu ad tlim kwarne, kwarara ba itar kǝ itsawar ad dǝge a dzoghǝr bi. Itsera kǝ sart ǝn kwargin kwarne kwar ba itar bi, ka zu vuk dǝ kwardu laven itar.
Dǝgǝn na mangina a ndawatǝrǝf kǝ udakh char. Ka nǝv itar, “A mangan ad itsauɗa kalkal. A ba dǝ tǝngakh, da tsǝna lav. Liye kwal tǝkha kǝ kwarga lava, ka kwar lava.”
